requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT reports ISO/IEC 60559 SQRT conformance for X kind
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT(X) is true exactly for real kind type parameters for which SQRT conforms to ISO/IEC 60559:2020, and false otherwise.

pending.ieee-support-sqrt-kind-inquiry: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT(x) for default and selected nondefault real variables; true branch performs exact SQRT conformance cases, false branch records an unsupported skip, and mutation inverts the recorded logical result.
pending.ieee-support-sqrt-true-branch-exact-case: Probe concrete calls IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT(4.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(4.0); true branch asserts SQRT(4.0)==2.0. For signed-zero rows, concrete call IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) guards IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_POSITIVE_ZERO), IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_NEGATIVE_ZERO), and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE observers; assert SQRT(+0) remains nonnegative zero and SQRT(negative_zero) remains negative zero. Under RADIX(1.5)==2, DIGITS(1.5)>=4, and concrete call IEEE_SUPPORT_SUBNORMAL(1.5), choose even q by parity: MINEXPONENT(1.5)-3 on even parity, otherwise MINEXPONENT(1.5)-4; hand-check MINEXPONENT-DIGITS <= q <= MINEXPONENT-3, assert SQRT(SCALE(1.0_kind,q)) == SCALE(1.0_kind,q/2). For infinity and NaN rows, concrete calls IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5), IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(1.5), and IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(1.5) guard IEEE_VALUE(1.5,IEEE_POSITIVE_INF), IEEE_VALUE(1.5,IEEE_QUIET_NAN), IEEE_VALUE(1.5,IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), IEEE_IS_NAN observers, and IEEE_CLASS observers; assert SQRT(+inf)==+inf and quiet plus signaling NaN inputs have IEEE_IS_NAN results observed with IEEE_CLASS. IEEE_INVALID row references named preamble invalid-flag-nonhalting: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_INVALID); supported-halting branch calls IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(IEEE_INVALID,.FALSE.); unsupported-halting branch uses the GET procedure guard for IEEE_INVALID, calls IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(IEEE_INVALID,halt), proceeds only on halt==.FALSE., and skip branch records halt==.TRUE. The row then probes concrete call IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INVALID,1.5); supported-flag branch clears each exception flag only under its concrete IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag,1.5) guard before SQRT(-1.0), asserts IEEE_INVALID true after the call and result IEEE_IS_NAN under IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5). False branches record unsupported skip.

requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT without X reports all-real SQRT support
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT() is true exactly when IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT(X) is true for all real X, and false otherwise.

pending.ieee-support-sqrt-no-x-all-real-relation: Generate scalar representatives for every available real kind from ISO_FORTRAN_ENV REAL_KINDS, statically instantiating each kind as REAL(0.0,kind); assert IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT() .EQV. ALL of the instantiated IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT(REAL(0.0,kind)) results. This checks both directions: no-X true entails every X-form true, and all X-forms true entails no-X true. Mutation drops one kind-specific conjunct.
